title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
description: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. In this mode you can create, rename, and delete pages, sections, or notebooks as well as add or edit content in pages. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.
